spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  c.nombre as metric,
  COUNT(f.id) as value
FROM metrics.fact_security f
JOIN metrics.dim_capa c ON f.capa_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.nombre;

SELECT 
  CONCAT(e.metodo, ' ', e.path) as metric,
  ROUND(AVG(f.trp)) as value
FROM metrics.fact_performance f
JOIN metrics.dim_endpoint e ON f.endpoint_id = e.id
GROUP BY e.metodo, e.path
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  t.fecha as time,
  ROUND(AVG(f.trp)) AS value
FROM metrics.fact_performance f
JOIN metrics.dim_tiempo t ON f.tiempo_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.logged_at)
GROUP BY t.fecha
ORDER BY t.fecha ASC;

SELECT 
  t.fecha as time,
  f.tep as value
FROM metrics.fact_testing f
JOIN metrics.dim_tiempo t ON f.tiempo_id = t.id
ORDER BY t.fecha ASC;

SELECT
  t.fecha as time,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN v.severidad = 'critical' THEN 1 END) as "Crítica",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN v.severidad = 'high' THEN 1 END) as "Alta",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN v.severidad = 'medium' THEN 1 END) as "Media",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN v.severidad = 'low' THEN 1 END) as "Baja"
FROM metrics.fact_security f
JOIN metrics.dim_tiempo t ON f.tiempo_id = t.id
JOIN metrics.dim_vulnerabilidad v ON f.vulnerabilidad_id = v.id
GROUP BY t.fecha
ORDER BY t.fecha ASC;

spec.title: Top 10 Componentes (Archivos o Paquetes) más Vulnerables

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  f.componente_afectado as metric,
  COUNT(f.id) as value
FROM metrics.fact_security f
GROUP BY f.componente_afectado
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) as value
FROM metrics.fact_security f
JOIN metrics.dim_vulnerabilidad v ON f.vulnerabilidad_id = v.id
WHERE v.severidad = 'critical';
